name: westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_profile_combo_kill_focus
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConfigDialog::OnProfileComboKillFocus commits edited profile-combo text into the selected profile name and clears the dirty flag.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
USER32 SendMessageA and MFC CWnd::GetWindowTextA(CString&) are verified as provider boundaries by smoke-test patches rather than by live combo-box UI execution.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x442010 validates a thiscall void handler that returns immediately when m_profileComboEditDirty is zero; otherwise it sends CB_DELETESTRING for m_selectedProfileIndex, reads the combo text into m_profilePlayerNames[m_selectedProfileIndex] through CWnd::GetWindowTextA(CString&), sends CB_INSERTSTRING with the updated CString text and selected index, and clears m_profileComboEditDirty.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_profile_combo_kill_focus_smoke patches USER32 SendMessageA and MFC CWnd::GetWindowTextA(CString&), verifies the no-op clean path, then verifies delete/read/insert order, selected index, edited CString storage, inserted text pointer contents, and dirty-flag clearing.
